wire.headline: Energy firm reports revenue growth but cuts jobs and closes plants
sentences: Revenue rose by 7% year over year to reach 4.26bn GBP in the quarter ending 30 September.
Pre-tax profit fell by 12% to 310m GBP.
The company announced 850 job cuts, which represents about 6% of its workforce.
Two gas plants are scheduled to close by March 2027, with one location in Wales and the other in Kent.
CEO Marian Holt stated that cost pressure is sharper than expected.
Ofgem has opened an investigation into the company's billing system.
The dividend was held at 12.4p a share.
Shares dropped by 4.2% in morning trading.

ND.headline: Energy firm faces profit drop and job cuts as regulators and unions prepare for action

sentences.text: The company's pre-tax profit decreased by 12% to 310m GBP.
